title: Reusable workflow inherits every secret in yaml — review required
description: secrets: inherit passes every secret available to the caller into the called workflow, including ones the called job does not need. A compromised or over-broad reusable workflow then reads credentials unrelated to its purpose. Pass named secrets instead, and let the callee declare exactly what it consumes.
remediation: Replace secrets: inherit with an explicit map of the secrets the called workflow needs.
limitation: Lexical: matches the inherit keyword; actual secret usage inside the callee is out of scope.
